name: Thrór's Map
game_text:
Plays to your support area.
<phase>Fellowship</phase> or <phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert a Hobbit to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
flavor_text: Bilbo still keeps a map of Erebor, the Lonely Mountain, as a memento of his journey with the Dwarves many years ago.
